results.title: Free Pascal wiki
results.snippet: Lazarus has some gaps in its user documentation and so this Wiki is a place where anyone can edit, improve and expand the Lazarus documentation. New to Wikis? No problem. See the WikiPedia Tutorial. A Sand Box is available for new Wiki users to practise in before editing real content.

results.title: Lazarus Homepage
results.snippet: Lazarus has a huge community of people supporting each other. It include scientists and students, pupils and teachers, professionals and hobbyists. Our wiki provides tutorials, documentation and ideas.

results.title: Lazarus Documentation - Free Pascal wiki
results.snippet: The document provides documentation on Lazarus, an open-source cross-platform visual development framework for Pascal and Object Pascal. It includes tutorials for Lazarus and Pascal, user guides covering installation, the IDE, LCL component ...

results.title: Lazarus (software) - Wikipedia
results.snippet: Lazarus does not support the following, which Delphi does: Datasnap (uses Embarcadero proprietary enterprise functions, not a publicly documented system) ... .NET libraries (.NET code, however, can invoke Object Pascal code or anything other machine-native library via Platform Invocation Services.)
